'''Sarrahban''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sarrahban system/Legends|Sarrahban system]],<ref name="TRG1-115" /> located within the [[Cyrillian Protectorate/Legends|Cyrillian Protectorate]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> It hosted a [[Unidentified Sarrahban species|native species]], and attempted to remain neutral in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] despite both sides attempting to persuade them to join. The Empire, however, got tired of Sarrahban's neutrality and launched an [[Invasion of Sarrahban|invasion]] of the world. During the battle, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] members from the local [[Rebel cell (Sarrahban)|partisan force]] attempted to escape aboard the ''[[Harvest Moon]]'', a [[Grain/Legends|grain]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. It was shot down by Imperial forces, but Alliance agents managed to repair the ship and escape, taking Rebel refugees and the planet's reserve of stabilized [[ytterbium]] with them.<ref name="TRG1-115" />
